item.title: Johnson County Emergency Management cancels January siren test
item.description: Hunter 01/08/26 Due to overcast conditions, Johnson County Emergency Management has canceled today’s outdoor warning siren test. The January monthly test will not be rescheduled. Normal monthly testing will resume Wednesday February 4th at 10am, weather permitting.
